appraisal_events.evidence: je pus bien vite me rendre compte combien il était aimé et populaire; le prestige qu'avait à leurs yeux le jeune homme... vu souper au Café de la Paix avec le duc d'Uzès et le prince d'Orléans; même le majestueux capitaine... semblait, par comparaison, trop solennel et presque commun; il monte avec un autre chic!
appraisal_events.explanation: Saint-Loup is elevated through his popularity among fellow soldiers, the prestige attached to his glimpsed aristocratic associations, and repeated comparisons in which he outshines even the senior captain in elegance and chic; the narrator directly affirms this popularity rather than merely reporting it neutrally.

status_effects.explanation: Saint-Loup's local standing rises clearly: he is admired and talked about by fellow soldiers, gains prestige from association with titled dining companions, and is favorably compared to a superior officer who seems commonplace beside him.
